# [TASK] Kubernetes manifests: Kustomize base + local/azure/aws overlays

## Task
Build the Kustomize structure from ARCHITECTURE.md §11.3 for all implemented services: base manifests plus local/azure/aws overlays.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `base/` has a Deployment+Service per stateless service and a StatefulSet+Service with `volumeClaimTemplates` for MongoDB, Redis and Postgres, with readiness/liveness probes and resource requests/limits on every workload (`grep -L 'readinessProbe\|resources:' infrastructure/kubernetes/base/*/{deployment,statefulset}.yaml` — empty)
- [x] `overlays/local` builds every service; `overlays/azure`/`overlays/aws` build the full local-parity set (api-gateway, movie/actor/user/ai-service, MongoDB, Postgres, Redis, Ollama — widened past the original core slice by #151), with tuned JVM heap flags per service and single replicas, unpatched from base's default (`grep -h replicas: infrastructure/kubernetes/base/*/*.yaml infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/{azure,aws}/*.yaml` — only `replicas: 1`)
- [x] `kubectl apply -k` succeeds per overlay (`kubectl kustomize infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/{local,azure,aws}` builds all three; local additionally ran live on minikube, azure/aws against the real clusters #26/#27 provisioned)
- [x] End-to-end movie request verified through the real local ingress path: `Ingress -> api-gateway -> movie-service -> MongoDB`, both the TMDB-shaped movie facade and person facade (manual: `minikube tunnel`, then `curl` through the Ingress host against `/api/v1/movies` and `/api/v1/persons`)
- [x] No secrets committed in plaintext — each overlay's `secretGenerator` reads a gitignored `secrets.env`; only `secrets.env.example` templates are committed (`git ls-files infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays | grep secrets.env` lists only `*.example` files)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 10

## Notes
`infrastructure/kubernetes/{deployments,services,configmaps,secrets}` (directories an earlier plan expected to migrate) never existed in this repo's git history — nothing to migrate.

`overlays/azure`/`overlays/aws` widened from the original core slice (api-gateway + movie-service + MongoDB + Redis) to the full local-parity set in #151; the second criterion above reflects the current scope, not the one this Task shipped with.

Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §11.3
